question: A large number of terracotta toys were found at which site of the Indus Valley Civilization?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mohenjodaro**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mohenjodaro**, one of the most significant cities of the **Indus Valley Civilization**, is located in present-day Pakistan.
 
• It is considered one of the earliest urban settlements in the world, showcasing advanced features like planned city layouts, drainage systems, and granaries.
